candidates.summary: TestStart_DefaultLogLevel may stay green with the default put back to debug
candidates.failure_scenario: start.go reverts to zapcore.DebugLevel.String() and the test still passes, so the default the PR fixes is unpinned
candidates.verify_by: go test -run 'TestStart_DefaultLogLevel$' ./gno.land/cmd/gnoland/ at head, then with start.go:155 set back to DebugLevel: expect FAIL

candidates.summary: another long-running binary in the tree may still default its log level to debug
candidates.failure_scenario: gnokms, gnofaucet or gnoweb run beside a node with a debug default and fill the same disk
candidates.verify_by: grep every "log-level" flag and every zapcore.DebugLevel assignment over the whole tree and read each default

candidates.summary: an event an operator needs at startup may log only at debug, so the info default hides it
candidates.failure_scenario: a genesis tx fails to deliver under -skip-failing-genesis-txs and the failure is a Debug line, invisible at the new default
candidates.verify_by: read the Logger() level of every genesis-replay failure path in gno.land/pkg/gnoland/app.go

candidates.summary: the callout tells operators on older binaries to pass -log-level info but names no way to tell an older binary
candidates.failure_scenario: an operator reading 'releases before that change' cannot tell whether the binary they run is one, since the README names no release or version
candidates.verify_by: read README.md:62-66 for a release, version or command that shows the binary's default
